name: register_test_backend
title: Selects testthat or tinytest as the backend for later expectations

origin.description: Selects testthat or tinytest as the backend for later expectations.
origin.details: Selects testthat or tinytest as the backend for later expectations.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(checkmate))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tibble))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(R6))
obj <- R6Class("Bar", public = list(a = 5), private = list(b = 42))$new()
fn <- function(x) x
print(register_test_backend("testthat"))
